# Step 1: inspect resume candidates metadata
resume_candidates = [
    '/home/vickie/documents/work/resume.pdf',
    '/home/vickie/trash/resume.pdf'
]
infos = []
for p in resume_candidates:
    info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=file_system_access_token)
    infos.append((p, info.get('updated_at'), info.get('created_at'), info.get('file_id', None), len(info.get('content','')) if 'content' in info else None))
print('resume_file_infos:')
for item in infos:
    print(item)

# choose non-trash with latest updated_at
# assume trash path contains '/trash/'
non_trash = [p for p in resume_candidates if '/trash/' not in p]
if non_trash:
    # pick latest among them
    candidates = non_trash
else:
    candidates = resume_candidates

best = None
best_updated = None
for p in candidates:
    info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=file_system_access_token)
    upd = info.get('updated_at')
    if best is None or (upd is not None and upd > best_updated):
        best = p
        best_updated = upd
print('chosen_resume_path', best, 'updated_at', best_updated)

    all_entries = []

            access_token=gmail_access_token,
            to_email=recipient,
            min_created_at=min_dt,
            max_created_at=max_dt,
            attachment=True,
            page_index=page_index,

        )

    return all_entries
